page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Inline references in italic follow the questions at the ends of their lines. Four centred section headings divide the questions. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: 12. Utrum Ars, an vero Natura praestantior? 2.phy-sic.2.
main_text.head: GEOMETRICA.
main_text.p: 13. Circuli quadratura,iuxta Hippocratem quendā Geometram praestantissimum, & Bryssonem quoq; Mathematicum, & alios, utrum detur? 1. Elenchor. Sophist.c.10.& 1.Analyt.Post.t.67.Comm.
main_text.head: LOGICA.
main_text.p: 14. An solius substantiae fit Definitio? 7.Metaphysicor. Sum.2.cap.4.
15. An unum uni duntaxat contrarium? 1.de cælo t.10. & 10.Metaphys.14. & 17.
main_text.head: ETHICA SEV POLITICA.
main_text.p: 16. Verecundia an virtutis nomine laudem mereatur? 4.Ethicor.9.
17. Sapientia, an vero Prudentia, praestantior virtus? 10.Ethicor.7.
18. Felicitas Ciuitatis,& singulorum,an eadem vel diuersa? 7 Polit.c.2.
19. Artifices quoq; an posint ciues esse in ciuitate-beata? M. Cic. ⌣Arist.7.Politic.c.9.

20. Respublica etiam Platonis, utrum locum me-reatur? In qua nihil communius, quàm omnia com-munia esse. Vid ⌣Arist.2.Politi.c.1. Cum vero nihil inaequalius quàm omnia aequalia esse, Utopia Mori an illa probanda? Dinoth. de Repub.eleg. dict.
main_text.head: PHYSIMEDICA.
main_text.p: 21. Quam ob caussam cum ex quatuor elementis constemus, id est, igne, aere, aqua, & terra: non tamen quatuor, sed tria duntaxat illa contineamus genera, humidum, solidum, & spirituosum? ⌣Aristot. & Alexand. in Prob.
22. Utrū genitura ex uniuerso corpore ad vasa sper-matica feratur? Πολυθρύλλητος.

page.notes: No page number, running head or signature is printed. The leading number of question 12 is printed as a large numeral and read as 12. In question 14 the word "Metaphysicor." breaks at the line end without a visible hyphen, so it is written whole. In question 15 "cælo" is read with some doubt. The symbol ⌣ before "Arist." and "Aristot." is a mark in the print that is not a plain letter; it is copied as a symbol. In question 16 "mereatur" breaks at the line end without a visible hyphen, so it is written whole.
